messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑look table of the **long weekends** that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a public holiday that falls on a Friday or a Monday, giving you a three‑day break (Friday‑Saturday‑Sunday or Friday‑Saturday‑Sunday‑Monday).  

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Long Weekend? | Notes |
|---------|-------------|-------------|---------------|-------|
| **Good Friday** | April 7 | Friday | ✅ | Creates a Friday‑Saturday‑Sunday break. |
| **Family Day** (Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Ontario, etc.) | February 20 | Monday | ✅ | Creates a Friday‑Saturday‑Sunday‑Monday break in those provinces. |
| **Victoria Day** | May 22 | Monday | ✅ | Creates a Friday‑Saturday‑Sunday‑Monday break. |
| **Labour Day** | September 4 | Monday | ✅ | Creates a Friday‑Saturday‑Sunday‑Monday break. |
| **Thanksgiving** | October 9 | Monday | ✅ | Creates a Friday‑Saturday‑Sunday‑Monday break. |
| **Christmas** | December 25 | Monday | ✅ | Creates a Friday‑Saturday‑Sunday‑Monday break. |

### Holidays that did **not** create a long weekend in 2023

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Reason |
|---------|-------------|-------------|--------|
| New Year’s Day | January 1 | Sunday | Falls on a Sunday; no extra day off. |
| Canada Day | July 1 | Saturday | Falls on a Saturday; no extra day off. |
| Remembrance Day | November 11 | Saturday | Falls on a Saturday; no extra day off. |
| Boxing Day | December 26 | Tuesday | Falls on a Tuesday; no extra day off. |

> **Tip for your holiday‑planning app:**  
> - If you want to support all provinces, remember that **Family Day** is only a holiday in certain provinces (Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Ontario, etc.).  
> - For a national view, you can simply highlight the five holidays above that create long weekends.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the list broken down by province or if you need additional details!
